failures.cause: GCEZone._now() was changed from datetime.utcnow() (naive UTC) to datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) (aware UTC), but the test asserts zone._now().tzinfo is None.
failures.fix: Keep using datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) for SEC-1042, but have _now() return naive UTC again with .replace(tzinfo=None) so the public _now() contract and test stay aligned (the strip in _get_time_until_mw can then be removed as redundant).
